question: Does the production Python source tree have any path that can construct a scientific AuthorityProposal or mutate scientific authority outside the registered protected ingress, such that untrusted/live agent output could bypass the hardened gateway when a future runtime caller is added?
strongest_parent: merged agent/raw-JSON authority gateway plus v3 protected scientific-authority/noninterference runtime
pre_outcome_observation: On the frozen base tree, repository search finds production AuthorityProposal construction only in src/rakl/agent_authority_gateway.py; production promote_scientific_authority calls only in that gateway; raw gateway functions have no production callers yet. Therefore deferred second-parser smuggling is not currently reachable, while source-level bypass by a future/new production caller remains the next enforceable boundary.
successor: AST/source-tree choke-point checker that rejects unregistered production construction or mutation of scientific authority
hard_gates: all production Python files parse successfully under the checker
no AuthorityProposal constructor outside the registered gateway
no promote_scientific_authority call outside the registered gateway
no commit_verified/revoke/supersede authority-ledger mutation outside v3_scientific_authority
checker detects registered hostile bypass fixtures for direct constructor, aliased constructor, module-qualified constructor, direct promotion and direct ledger mutation
existing agent/raw gateway and v3 scientific-authority/noninterference tests remain green
falsifier: Any production bypass not detected by the checker, or any legitimate existing protected path broken by the checker, rejects the successor.
claim_if_green: Within the checked Python production tree and registered authority APIs, scientific proposal construction and authority mutation are source-enforced through explicit choke points; this is a framework conformance result, not a live-model empirical leakage-rate result.
forbidden_claims: a live model has been empirically shown unable to attack the gateway
next_if_green: When a real model/agent authority ingress is wired, bind that caller to submit_raw_untrusted_agent_authority_json and run fresh generated-payload assurance; until then do not invent a live-output path.
